criteria.evidence: All five guided sections plus Agent intent (ICE) are substantive: What it does states when it runs ("the search runs on request, when a person or a play asks for a domain"; "The keep-out check is part of the spine linter (lint_grounding.py --spine). It runs each time that linter runs"), Inputs/Outputs name fields (`id`, `intents`, `domain`, `kind`, `issue`), Rules cover one-sided links, unknown domain ids, empty domains and Garura's `domains: []`, nine Given/When/Then criteria, and Out of scope names owners (/discover-domains, fn-724, fn-725, cap-719).

"It never stops a write, because the parent capability has the rule that nothing is blocked. The Alignment loop writes the missing side."; "A domain lists its capabilities only through those capability entries, so there is one place to change."; "Each of these is an error, because domains set which areas the product covers, not which work is done."; "The search reads only files and changes nothing, so it can run at any time."

Sections are discrete bullets; the function is stated as behavior ("A domain lists the business intents and capabilities in it"), never as a user story; acceptance is Given/When/Then, e.g. "Given a spine where a domain entry has an `issue` field, or a plan file with a node of kind domain that holds an issue number, when the check runs, then it fails with an error that names the domain and the issue number."

Parent gives one line: "Domains for search (fn-726): a search by domain shows its business intents and capabilities. A domain never shows in a plan or in the tracker." The child adds the exact fields read, the both-sides rule, the "one-sided" and "not in the spine" marks, warning-vs-error branches, and how the keep-out check detects a domain issue from files only.

What: "for a domain id, the search gives the business intents that touch it and the capabilities in it, each with its page link." Why: "The model keeps it only for finding things" and "domains set which areas the product covers, not which work is done." Edges: "Writing domain pages and adding a domain to the spine. /discover-domains owns that."; "Deciding readiness. fn-724 owns it". Terms such as the spine and ICE are defined in place.
